newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines cuts oil prices by avg 7.02 centavos.
newsitem.headline: Philippines cuts oil prices by avg 7.02 centavos.

text.p: The Energy Regulatory Board (ERA) of the Philippines said on Friday that it will cut the prices of petroleum products by an average of 7.02 centavos per litre.
The reduction will come into effect from 6 a.m. on Saturday (2200 GMT Friday), it said.
Prices of liquid petroleum gas and fuel oil were among those slashed but there was no change in regular gasoline and diesel prices, the ERA said.
Liquid petroleum gas prices were cut by 38.90 centavos to 6.7021 pesos per litre. Fuel oil charges will fall 25.99 centavos to 4.1712 pesos per litre, the board said.
Premium gasoline prices were reduced 1.64 centavos to 10.74 pesos per litre while unleaded gasoline was reduced by 1.85 centavos to 10.73 pesos per litre.
Jet fuel prices were raised 7.65 centavos to 9.8325 pesos per litre while kerosene prices remained the same.

The board adjusts petroleum product prices each month on the basis of Singapore Posted Prices. The November adjustment, which raised prices by an average of 79.75 centavos per litre, was delayed until last week because of opposition from some politicians.
